A unified wide wedge-shaped lifting body with a softly truncated blunt nose, two SHORT integrated shoulder sections; only THREE OR FOUR major smoothly resolved primary masses. Engines are recessed into the rear hull rather than mounted as separate pods. A short restrained horizontal dark-glass cockpit band, closed cargo hatch, exactly three simple robust landing supports with elegant plain fairings. Broad smooth pale warm-ivory ceramic hull panels with precise generous bevels and gentle radii, graphite belly, ONE thin continuous burnt-orange accent stripe, very few panel seams and working lamps. Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original AAA science-fiction game spaceship concept; premium photoreal engineering product render.
Primary request: ONE complete original HUMAN EXPEDITION SHUTTLE named internally SWIFT, approximately 19 metres long. This is a fresh, meticulously maintained, contemporary luxury-quality industrial spacecraft. Beautiful restrained surface design, clean elegant proportions and real habitable interior volume. It is not a military fighter or a sharp-nosed airplane.

Large forms and silhouette: only THREE or FOUR simple principal masses. A LONG SLENDER central pressure hull with an integrated spacious forward cockpit and a walk-in standing-height central cabin. The body must visibly have room for humans to stand inside: approximately 3.5 metres of exterior height, not a paper-thin single-seat fighter. A softly TRUNCATED, gently chamfered nose, not a needle or a pointed cone. One narrow dark horizontal cockpit visor is integrated flush into the front upper surface; no bubble canopy or busy cockpit glazing. Two SHORT REAR INTEGRATED WEDGES merge smoothly into the aft shoulders of the central hull. They are compact stabilizing/propulsion cheek volumes, not long wings, external engine pods or separate jet engines. Together they create an elongated, composed, subtly forward-directed silhouette with a calm precise visual rhythm. Integrated propulsion; a pair of simple clean rear thrust slots, recessed into the rear body. Keep the fuselage dominant, with restrained functional aft cheek forms.
Landing configuration: THREE simple sturdy low landing supports with clean fairings and compact pads, clearly attached to sensible reinforced points. One small flush access seam may imply a hatch; no complex exposed ramp mechanism.

Materials and colour: large smooth LIGHT IVORY CERAMIC/composite panels with subtly controlled curvature and chamfered edges. GRAPHITE underside and a small amount of dark joint material. ONE thin ORANGE stripe follows a major hull line. Very few long intentional panel seams and very few tiny instrument lights. Excellent surface continuity, broad clean highlights, tactile but near-new materials. Minimal use wear: no scuffs or dirt patina. Expensive engineered hardware rather than a toy, miniature or low-poly model.

Composition/framing: high-resolution LANDSCAPE, single full spacecraft in a FRONT THREE-QUARTER view from a SLIGHTLY ELEVATED camera, enough of the top and side visible to judge the elongated cabin volume, integrated rear wedges and three landing supports. Entire vehicle fully inside the image with comfortable margins; no cropping. One TINY neutral HUMAN standing silhouette close to a landing support establishes true 19-metre scale; the person is clearly about 1.8 metres tall, much smaller than the shuttle, and secondary. No other vehicles.
Scene/backdrop: minimal light gray-blue neutral studio cyclorama with matching simple floor and soft realistic contact shadows, clean quiet presentation. No scenery, hangar clutter, atmospheric particles, dramatic fog or planets.
Lighting/mood: soft natural DAYLIGHT studio illumination, controlled wide reflections and enough fill to see the graphite underside. High-end photoreal automotive/aerospace industrial design presentation; cinematic AAA quality through proportion and material, not through grime or excessive detailing. Original design at the technical finish quality of a premium modern science-fiction game, without copying any existing franchise model.
Constraints: ONE spacecraft only, one small human scale marker, three landing supports, large simple smooth forms, new well-maintained surfaces. NO text, captions, logos, labels, numbers, watermark, insets, diagrams, orthographic views or sheet borders. NO exposed trusses, pipes, bolts, cables, grilles, vents covering surfaces, scratches, chipped paint, military guns, missiles, external jet engines, detached aircraft engine pods, huge wings, pointed airplane nose, needle-like projections, busy greebles, excessive little lights, decorative glowing seams or dense panel lines. NO Star Citizen, Star Wars or Mass Effect model copies. Keep the design visually clean, substantial, believable, quietly fast and beautiful.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original human expedition shuttle concept for the game Stellar Drift.
Primary request: a distinctly CLEAN MODERN premium spacecraft design with an immediately recognizable silhouette, broad uninterrupted surfaces and a very small number of functional details. This is a new alternative to overly busy industrial spacecraft. Make elegance of proportion and surface design the main achievement.
Subject: MANTA, a compact 19-metre two-person atmosphere-capable exploration shuttle with a broad low lifting-body silhouette. One continuous shallow swept trapezoidal hull, a gently chamfered blunt forward nose and short thick integrated shoulders. The central walk-in cabin is a clean raised volume flowing into the hull, with one precise narrow dark forward window band. The hull has real thickness for cabin and a small cargo bay. Two narrow recessed engine outlets are integrated into the rear trailing face, no external engine nacelles. One discreet closed rear access ramp. Three simple sturdy landing supports with broad pads.
Design language: only three or four strongly composed primary masses. Approximately eighty percent of the visible skin is calm, smooth panel area. Warm off-white ceramic/composite upper shell, dark graphite underside and glass, one thin muted orange accent line. Clean restrained functional cyan light only at the engine outlet. Carefully sculpted fillets and chamfers, deliberate transitions between surfaces, beautiful controlled highlights. A credible expensive manufactured expedition craft with the design clarity of premium modern science-fiction vehicles. Original intellectual property; do not reproduce any existing franchise ship.
Composition: exactly ONE entire spacecraft, front three-quarter view from a slightly raised camera, full craft and landing gear completely inside the frame with generous breathing room. A tiny single standing 1.8-metre technician beside it gives scale and does not compete. Light neutral blue-gray seamless studio floor and backdrop, soft daylight and controlled shadows. Wide landscape image, crisp realistic high-end product visualization, physically believable materials. No cinematic scene clutter.
Avoid: greebles, clusters of mechanical bits, bolt patterns, little maintenance panels everywhere, exposed pipes, cables, trusses, dangling equipment, decorative radiator combs, huge separate thrusters, machine guns, aggressive fighter styling, heavy weathering, rusty edges, scratches, dirt, chipped paint, noisy textures, complex articulated armor petals, toy or low-poly appearance.
Text: NONE. No titles, numbers, labels, logos, slogans, watermarks, borders, inset views, diagrams or interface.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: original science-fiction spacecraft concept.
Input image: edit target and composition/silhouette reference.
Primary request: refine this extremely smooth spacecraft into a CLEAN BUT FUNCTIONALLY DESIGNED modern expedition shuttle. Retain the broad low lifting-body silhouette, central cabin, whole-ship front three-quarter camera, light gray studio backdrop and floor, one tiny human for scale and three landing supports. Preserve the calm large surface areas and restrained ivory/graphite/orange palette.
Change the design from soft seamless consumer-product styling to confident large FACETED engineered surfaces with broad planar chamfers, crisp transitions and shallow relief. The silhouette must remain simple and memorable. Retain 70–80 percent quiet panel area, but visibly resolve five or six MEDIUM-SCALE functional features: a single large inset forward avionics cover; a carefully framed angular dark cockpit window band; two recessed rectangular maneuvering-thruster wells in the forward shoulder corners; two integrated stout rear engine housings blended into the shoulders with deep dark outlets; one large closed side access/ramp seam; and broad segmented graphite thermal protection panels beneath the nose. Landing supports should show one honest fold joint per support and a defined separate foot, without exposed hoses or micro-mechanical detail. Panel seams follow the major load-bearing volumes, not a random decorative grid. A few deliberate matte titanium edge inserts add material contrast. Use two small rectangular muted orange identification/service patches instead of a continuous automotive orange pinstripe.
High quality detailed surface shading and real material construction, but very low decorative detail density. Smooth satin ivory ceramic, dark graphite underbody, dark titanium functional pockets. Clean maintained spacecraft, subtle natural material texture, no dirt, scratches, rust or chipped paint. No weaponry. AAA contemporary science-fiction art direction, beautiful controlled lighting and intentional proportions, original vehicle rather than a copied franchise design.
Do not add pipes, exposed trusses, dense ventilation grills, rows of bolts, cables, spines, machine guns, tiny panels everywhere, extra pods, inscriptions, logos, title, diagram, inset view or other spacecraft. Avoid a toy, train, glossy yacht or featureless bar of soap. The goal is a clear technological craft with hierarchy of large and medium forms, not visual noise. Exactly one complete ship with breathing room in landscape composition.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original science-fiction exploration equipment concept plate; premium photoreal industrial product design.
Primary request: ONE clean landscape product presentation containing exactly THREE clearly separated complete objects from the same human expedition equipment family: a principal palm-held survey scanner, a small wrist display, and a compact repair multitool. Simplify aggressively. Beauty comes from restrained proportions, precise surfaces and clear function, not intricate mechanical decoration.

1. MAIN SCANNER, largest object: a compact HORIZONTAL one-piece rounded rectangular body that rests across the palm, with a simple broad concealed hand strap on its rear surface. No downward handle. ONE rectangular inset display showing only a simple quiet cyan measurement curve, and ONE tactile physical adjustment dial. ONE clearly understandable C-SHAPED SENSOR JAW folds out from one short edge of the body, a single elegant continuous C-shaped element with two small inward-facing sensor tips. The folding hinge is concealed inside the smooth body. The C jaw is short, sturdy, broad and precise, not spiky, toothed or gun-shaped. Large unbroken ceramic surfaces. No detachable probe, external antenna, cable or extra tool attachment.
2. WRIST DISPLAY, smaller: ONE thin simple graphite cuff with a single low-profile ivory display module integrated smoothly into the cuff. ONE small screen only. Minimal clean straps with no intricate buckles.
3. REPAIR MULTITOOL, smaller: ONE dense smooth compact rounded rectangular hand tool with a single short interchangeable working tip at one end, like a protected precision hex driver. One working tip only; no bouquet of blades, pliers, saw teeth, multiple fold-out appendages or sharp weapons. The tool body is clean and solid with ergonomic graphite contact areas.

Shared colour and materials: premium LIGHT IVORY ceramic/composite shells, GRAPHITE soft-touch ergonomic surfaces, one very thin restrained ORANGE accent on each object, very little functional cyan illumination. Smooth high-quality near-new materials, beautifully controlled curvature, seamless large panels and only essential long seams. Photoreal surface roughness and realistic material transitions, not glossy toy plastic, low-poly geometry or miniature styling. No decorative tiny components.
Composition: high-resolution LANDSCAPE, exactly three objects fully visible with large comfortable negative spaces between them and generous outside margins. Main scanner on the left, medium-large and visually dominant, wrist display and compact multitool separately arranged to the right. All objects share a slightly elevated three-quarter product-photography view and consistent plausible relative scale. No hands, extra objects, inset views, exploded parts or additional versions.
Scene and lighting: clean LIGHT neutral gray studio cyclorama and floor, broad soft daylight studio lighting, mild contact shadows, every object clearly readable, no dark dramatic backdrop or glare over screens.
Constraints: exploration and repair instruments, NEVER firearms. No pistol grip, gun trigger, barrel, scope or hidden-gun silhouette. No exposed bolts, rivets, valves, dangling pipes, cables, grilles, scratched surfaces, chipped paint, dirty patina, teeth, stickers, logos, labels, text walls, readable writing, captions, numbers, watermark, borders or schematic graphics. Exactly THREE simple complete products, one clear function per object, premium believable human industrial engineering.
